newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba plans to create around 15,000 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Veba plans to create around 15,000 jobs.

text.p: German diversified utility Veba AG said on Wednesday that it planned to create 15,000 jobs both in and outside Germany over the next five years.

Ulrich Hartmann, management board chairman of Veba, said around 10,000 of those jobs would be in the telecommunications sector, which would mostly be in Germany, while around two-thirds of the remaining 5,000 jobs would come from abroad.
In 1997 Veba plans to up its payroll outside Germany by between 2,000 and 2,500 employees, but did not plan to increase its employee numbers in Germany.
The group said that it planned instead to introduce job-sharing and part-time work to spread the existing workload around.
In 1996 the number of employees at Veba shrunk by 3,000 to 122,100, through the sale of individual sectors.
